title: Get all replies to a comment
content_data:
Use this endpoint to access all replies to a specific comment (along with related information) - both public and hidden - that have been created against a comment on an organic video posted by an owned TikTok Account. >**Note**
>
  • `/business/comment/reply/list/`currently does not support getting replies to a hidden comment.
  • The comment webhook event [comment.update](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810515104773122) enables you to get notifications within five minutes of a comment reply being created, deleted, or the reply visibility settings being modified on any public video associated with an owned TikTok account. To subscribe to the comment webhook, see [Subscribe to the comment update event](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1810521730276354#item-link-Subscribe%20to%20the%20comment%20update%20event).
## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/business/comments/replies/list/|/v1.3/business/comment/reply/list/| |Method|POST |GET| |New response parameters| / |`unique_identifier`
`parent_comment_id`
`display_name`
`image_url` | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/reply/list/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
To obtain an access token, use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041).| ``` **Parameters** Pass params as url parameters. ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required} | string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.
Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1833997638479041) to this field.| | video_id {Required} | string | Unique identifier for owned TikTok video to list comments on. This can be accessed via the [/business/video/list/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1762228421622786) endpoint as the `item_id` for each video listed. | | comment_id {Required} | string | Unique identifier for comment on an owned TikTok video to list replies on.
This can be accessed via the [/business/comment/list/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1760232109619202) endpoint as the `comment_id` for each comment listed. | | status | string | Enumerated status of comment reply visibility.

Enum values:
  • `PUBLIC`: Comment replies are publicly viewable by all TikTok users.
  • `ALL`: Comment replies are both hidden from view as well as publicly viewable by all TikTok users.

Default value: `ALL`. | | sort_field | string | Specific field to sort comment replies by.

Enum values:
  • `likes`: Sort comment replies by the number of likes in the specified `sort_order`.
  • `replies`: Sort comment replies by the number of replies in the specified `sort_order`.
  • `create_time`: Sort comment replies chronologically in the specified `sort_order`.
By default, the comment replies will be returned in a random order. | | sort_order | string | Specific field to sort comment replies by.

Enum values:
  • `asc`: Sort comment replies in ascending order by the specified `sort_field`.
  • `desc`: Sort comment replies in descending order by the specified `sort_field`.

By default, the comment replies will be sorted according to semantics. | | cursor | integer | Cursor for pagination. If the response parameter `has_more` is true, pass the returned cursor in this parameter in the subsequent request to receive the next page of results.

Default value: 0. | | max_count | integer | The maximum number of comment replies that will be returned for each page of data.

Default value: 20.

Minimum value: 0.

Maximum value: 30.

Note: Due to our trust and safety policies, it is possible that the endpoint returns less than the `max_count` number of comments even if the response parameter `has_more` is true. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/comment/reply/list/?business_id={{business_id}}&video_id={{video_id}}&comment_id={{comment_id}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response **Header** These are important headers to record for issue reports and troubleshooting. This is not an exhaustive list of response headers. ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|--- | | Date | string | Date and time (GMT) when the response was received.
Example: Fri, 13 Aug 2021 08:04:42 GMT | | X-Tt-Logid | string | Unique identifier for the API request. | ``` **Response Body** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| | request_id | string | Unique identifier for the API request.

Please record this field for all API requests. Important for issue reports and troubleshooting. | | code | Integer | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| | message | string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | | data | object | Returned data. | #|comments | object[] | List of current page of replies to the specified comment created on the specified video. | ##|comment_id | string | Unique identifier for the reply.

Example: 6990565363377392901. | ##|parent_comment_id| string | The ID of the comment to which the reply (`comment_id`) is directed.

Example: 6990565363377392901.| ##|video_id| string | Unique identifier for the owned video the reply was created on.

Example: 6990565363377392901. | ##|user_id{-To-be-deprecated}| string | Developer application and TikTok account scoped unique identifier for the user that made the reply.

Example: ce9b7be629b0447af777a0ad945783f61b7f790982b49fbda04a23b4722eaffe.

Note: This field will be deprecated in the next API version. We recommend using `unique_identifier` to identify the TikTok user because the identifier remains consistent across different APIs. | ##| unique_identifier | string | A globally unique identifier assigned to each user commenting. This identifier remains consistent across different APIs, facilitating cross-referencing and integration.

Example: +ABc1D2/E0fGhijklMNOrD34vDW/zDiZUNRH5Jyahue6OcA7b8ZpwnqXV9u1Uh+k. | ##|create_time | string | Unix/Epoch date-time when the reply was created.

Example: 1627617835. | ##|text | string | Text content of the reply.

Example: "This is a reply #reply 🙂". ##|likes | integer | Number of likes the reply has received.

Example: 123. | ##|replies | integer | Number of replies the reply has received.

Example: 123. | ##|owner | boolean | Whether the current application user owns the reply.

Example: `true`. | ##|liked | boolean | Whether the current application user likes the reply.

Example: `true`. | ##|pinned | boolean | Whether the current application user pinned the reply.

Example: `true`. | ##|status | string | The visibility status of the reply.

Possible values:

  • `HIDDEN`: The reply is hidden from public viewership.
  • `PUBLIC`: The reply can be viewed by all users.

Example: `PUBLIC`.| ##|username | string | The username of the TikTok user who made the reply..

Example: feather_in_the_w1nd. | ##| display_name | string | The display name of the TikTok user who made the reply.

Example: Feather in the wind | ##|profile_image| string | The avatar link for the account. It will expire at the x-expires Unix/Epoch date-time in the link.

Example: https://p16-sign-va.tiktokcdn.com/tos-maliva-avt-0068/188d468fc1de3f328250ea0c96e98f8b~c5_168x168.jpeg?x-expires=1651687200&x-signature=AAiHg70%2Bnj9iUipTuQWodRmk0qA%3D. | ##| image_url | string | A URL to an image in the comment.

Returned if the comment is an image.

The URL won't expire.| #|cursor | integer | Cursor for the next page of results, to be passed in the cursor query parameter of the subsequent API request. | #|has_more | boolean | Whether an additional page of data is available. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "cursor": 2, "has_more": false, "comments": [ { "profile_image": "{{profile_image}}", "user_id": "{{user_id}}", "text": "{{text}}", "likes": 0, "username": "{{username}}", "display_name": "{{display_name}}", "parent_comment_id": "{{parent_comment_id}}", "owner": true, "status": "PUBLIC", "liked": false, "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "unique_identifier": "{{unique_identifier}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "comment_id": "{{comment_id}}" }, { "profile_image": "{{profile_image}}", "user_id": "{{user_id}}", "text": "{{text}}", "likes": 0, "username": "{{username}}", "display_name": "{{display_name}}", "parent_comment_id": "{{parent_comment_id}}", "owner": true, "status": "PUBLIC", "liked": false, "video_id": "{{video_id}}", "unique_identifier": "{{unique_identifier}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "comment_id": "{{comment_id}}" } ] } } (/code) ```
